source: docs/plan/INTENT-LADDER.md — normalisation step 6, T1's stop words, 'No number from vagueness', 'Negation is honoured', and T4's dates and currencies. Japanese has no spaces: these are matched as text within a clause, the single numerals 一–九, 十 and 百 compose (二十一 is 21), the native counts ひとつ–とお are words, and stop words are the bigram tokens they stand for. A word added here is a behaviour change: it needs a row in fixtures/ladder/ja.json in the same commit.
